description: Gold epistemic-status labels for the 'pretend everything is fine until the private paper is offloaded' market memo. Serves as the first target/eval case for the SCT epistemic-tagging guard, extending gated generation from formal languages to conceptual claims. The memo's own behaviour is the gold standard: the SUPPLY half is sourced and assertable; the COORDINATION/INTENT claim is unfalsifiable and must be reframed, not asserted.

axes.intent: the allocator-coordination half (claims about hidden intent)

claims.text: SpaceX S-1 filed 2026-05-20, ~$1.75-2T valuation, ~$75-80B raise, listing ~June 12
Combined >$200B of issuance vs a $45B total 2025 US IPO market
EA $55B LBO ($20B debt, largest non-IG commitment ever)
There is a vast inventory of private paper that needs a calm tape to be sold into
claims.note: directional inference licensed by the sourced supply facts, but itself unsourced

claims.text: Allocators are coordinating a 'hold the line' pattern
claims.note: hidden coordination; no possible public evidence could settle it

claims.text: Issuers/underwriters/PE sponsors are individually incentivized to keep the tape orderly into their own exits
claims.note: the structural-incentive reframe that replaces the unfalsifiable coordination claim
